mapper.select: select distinct m.perms from sys_menu m inner join sys_role_menu rm on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id inner join sys_role r on r.role_id = rm.role_id where m.status = '0' and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' and m.perms is not null and m.perms != '' and r.role_id in (select role_id from sys_user_role where user_id = #{userId})
